source_title: Notts County midfielder Maz Kouyhar returns to Kidderminster on loan - BBC
source_excerpt:
Maz Kouyhar has earned 10 caps for Afghanistan
Notts County midfielder Maz Kouhyar has returned to Kidderminster Harriers on loan until January 1.
The 29-year-old made 47 appearances during his spell with the Magpies and now returns to the Harriers, who he previously joined on loan from York City in 2024.
The club wished the Afghan international well , external as he begins a new chapter in his footballing career in the West Midlands.
